roadmapLane: P1-A: assemble one unsigned declared block from independent intent/subject, original price quote and supplied nonce/public bytes; actual SDK/native/live preparation remains separate.

implementation.flow: Descriptor-safe detached context/quote/material snapshots -> independent expected request snapshot -> existing original-quote draft producer -> shared exact306-byte unsigned hash computation -> existing strict hash/nonce/key/intent/price consumer for that SAME assembled record.
implementation.noRewrite: Accept no caller account block, hash, signature or payment object for rewriting. Preserve supplied nonce/public bytes, original quote fields, subject/intent and acknowledgement. No quote refresh, nonce search, key generation, signature or retry/replacement capability.
implementation.encoderReuse: The old unsigned hash validator and the new pure compute utility use one private encoder. Removing the new helper/export and inverting the literal extraction reproduces the prior planner source byte-for-byte.
implementation.snapshotSemantics: Ordinary DATA records and dense arrays only; no getters, proxies, foreign prototypes, functions, symbols, undefined, unsafe/negative numbers or caller coercion. No input object is frozen or mutated. Existing original component field grammars still apply after copying.
implementation.collectorPromotion: Only the unchanged previously authored pure collection-input snapshot helper is promoted with the collector. The old collector body remains byte-identical. The new assembly invokes that helper before awaiting and retains its independently derived declared request digest.
implementation.excludedOwner: The local HTTPS owner, its collection fixture and its collection result are not included. No owner module is imported/evaluated; native owner/lifecycle qualification stays NOT_RUN.
implementation.labels: UNSIGNED_DECLARED_FIELDS_ONLY, preparation NOT_PERFORMED, key possession and chain authentication NOT_ESTABLISHED, signature validation NOT_PERFORMED, authority/afterSigningAction NONE.
implementation.noActivation: This is declared DATA assembly, NOT ZenonTransactionPlanner.prepareUnsigned(), actual account-state/SDK preparation, a real PREPARE admission or an approval/signing/publication capability. The active legacy buyer/composite and defaults are untouched.

sourceReview.historicalResults: All previous result JSONs remain unchanged and describe their own immutable source pins, not refreshed current-head evidence.

selection.reason: Planner encoder extraction changes the imported graph; seven pin arrays only were refreshed. This is not a repeat on unchanged inputs.

qualification.positiveScope: Full declared fusion-only assembly with matching public bytes, original price allocation and original acknowledgement, computed actual hash, mutation isolation, and the existing maximum1024-spork-list shape.
qualification.negativeScope: Wrong material/version/arity, supplied hash/signature/payment for replacement, payer-key mismatch, stale/exhausted/misbound context, invalid supplied hybrid nonce despite a correct computed hash, hostile descriptors/proxies/cycles/excessive DATA, and overridden virtual callbacks.
qualification.notPositiveHybridEvidence: No valid hybrid nonce was searched/generated and no native/SDK work provider was executed. Fixed supplied nonce predicates and rejection cases do not close the actual preparation/signing/inclusion matrix.

qualification.retention: Complete native stdout/stderr, receipts, CAS creator ledgers and references were independently read; hashes/counts are reported here without a second public copy of the large TAP payload.
qualification.caveat: Node loader/runner/stream/native/OS behavior and trusted intrinsics remain premises. Test timeout, permission flags, sampled quota and later empty process-group observation are not hard OS/network sandbox, lifetime/cancellation or native-cleanup proof.
